summary: Every legal input is a fixed ten-character date, and the inclusive 1900 through 2100 source domain contains only 73,414 valid dates.

workload_bound.source_constraint: date.length == 10 and the date is valid from 1900-01-01 through 2100-12-31

replacement_checks.evidence: The accepted implementation splits at two fixed separators, parses exactly three bounded decimal components, formats each once, and joins three outputs.
Regression exhausts all 73,414 valid dates in the inclusive source interval and compares each result with an independent repeated-division binary oracle.
